description: IMPL §7. New 'Voice' section on settings page mirroring the existing model picker pattern. Native HTML radio buttons, one per shipped voice, with name + one-line description per option. Free users see disabled state with 'Pro only' tag. PUT to /api/preferences on change. BLOCKED BY §8 (eval gate) — do not expose a voice in the picker until it has passed the eval gate. See IMPL §7.

resolution.note: Voice section added to settings page mirroring model picker. Two-row card layout (name on row 1, description on row 2) for sentence-length descriptions. Free users see disabled state with PRO ONLY badge + upgrade link. PUT /api/preferences on change with optimistic update + rollback on failure (covers 403 gate path). Defensive fallback to scholar if API returns unknown slug. No direct React test (matches model picker pattern); API contract + runtime covered in api.test.ts. 337 tests pass.
